name: CascadeStudio
tagline: Sketch a profile, pull it into a solid. The model lives in the file — works offline.
description:
This copy runs entirely on your device. Close it and the last sketch is still there; share the GIF and the model goes with it. No install, no account, no FreeCAD.

Tap the plane to draw a closed profile, round the corners, set how far to pull it, and OpenCascade builds a real solid — not a triangle soup. A bracket plate is already open so you can orbit a part before you draw your own.

Press Invite in the bar above and a friend lands on the same sketch. Either of you can move a point; the solid rebuilds for both.

An unofficial port of Cascade Studio by Johnathon Selstad. Same B-rep kernel. The document is the GIF.
